title: Conception of a device for crosswind gust simulation in wind tunnel.
author: Francisco Clézio de Souza Júnior
abstract: A technique for simulation of crosswind gusts is developed as an attempt to analyze and improve the aerodynamic characteristics and efficiency of vehicles. In this way, it is designed a device capable of producing a sharp-edge, finite length gust as a method of changing quickly a forthcoming straight flow to a yawed one. This method admits the study of transient phenomenon and thus the obtainment of more realistic results at experimental tests in wind tunnel. Estimative calculus and experimental data are obtained to verify the functioning of this device and its approach to the real phenomenon.
